definitions.explanation: A lottery ticket with a coated area that is scratched off to reveal whether it has won. Short for スクラッチくじ. From English "scratch".

examples.japanese: スクラッチ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
⟦コイン→コイン：10852_koin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧スクラッチ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{削|けず}る→削る：03922_kezuru⟧。
examples.english: Scratch off the card with a coin.

examples.japanese: ⟦コンビニ→コンビニ：01081_konbini⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧スクラッチ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧1000⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧⟦{当|あ}たった→当たる：01860_ataru⟧。
examples.english: The scratch card I bought at the convenience store won 1,000 yen.

notes:
In everyday use this refers to the scratch-off lottery; the fuller form is スクラッチくじ.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- スクラッチ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{削|けず}る→削る：03922_kezuru⟧: to scratch off a card
- スクラッチ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧: to buy a scratch card
- スクラッチくじ: scratch-off lottery ticket

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{宝|たから}くじ→宝くじ：18549_takarakuji⟧: the standard drawn-number lottery, where results come from a later drawing
- {当|あ}たりくじ: a winning ticket
